# Addon capabilities and platforms are generated by the build

Authors no longer write `capabilities` or `platforms` in `manifest.json`. `ubd build` works out both from the code: supported platforms come from the keys passed to `definePlatform`, and each platform's capabilities come from the `native.*` calls reachable from that platform's handler, mapped through the same method-to-capability table the client enforces. The build writes them into the published `dist/manifest.json`. The client still checks them before the addon runs and on every native call, so the gate is unchanged. Only who writes the list changed.

We rejected two alternatives. Hand-written lists drift from the code, and a missing entry fails only on a user's device. A runtime `capabilities.register()` would let an addon grant itself access after review, so the gate would mean nothing. As a result, dynamic access such as `native.objc[name]` is a build error: the build can't see it.
